title: Squirrel in a little scarf
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M62 78 Q86 74 84 50 Q82 28 64 30 Q54 32 58 44 Q62 54 70 52 Q76 51 74 60 Q72 70 60 70 Z" fill="#e8933a" stroke="#f7c777" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M66 66 Q78 62 76 50 Q74 40 66 42" fill="none" stroke="#f7c777" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="66" rx="17" ry="16" fill="#d9822b"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="70" rx="10" ry="11" fill="#fbe3bd"/>
  <!-- haunch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="75" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#c4731f"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="82" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#b8661a"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="82" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#b8661a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="44" r="14" fill="#e8933a"/>
  <!-- ear left -->
  <path d="M33 33 Q30 22 38 30 Z" fill="#e8933a" stroke="#f7c777" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M34 32 Q33 26 37 30 Z" fill="#f7c777"/>
  <!-- ear right -->
  <path d="M50 32 Q52 21 55 30 Z" fill="#e8933a" stroke="#f7c777" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M51 31 Q52 26 54 30 Z" fill="#f7c777"/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="6" fill="#fbe3bd"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="48" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#fbe3bd"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="41" r="3" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="40" r="1" fill="#a9d8ff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="2" fill="#6b3a1f"/>
  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d="M28 56 Q42 62 56 55 L57 63 Q42 70 27 64 Z" fill="#3ac6e8" stroke="#8fe6fb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- scarf knot/tail -->
  <path d="M30 64 Q26 74 22 78 L28 78 Q33 73 35 65 Z" fill="#2fb0d4" stroke="#8fe6fb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="64" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#c4731f"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="68" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#c4731f"/>
</svg>
